patch_description:
The previous approach used 240 layouts, 3600 generations, unrestricted interior coordinates for all eight non-vertex points, and a coordinate-only polish. The new construction uses a lower-dimensional and more structured 13-parameter family: three points are explicitly constrained to the three container sides, while five remain free in barycentric coordinates. This makes boundary-supported configurations much easier to discover.

The evolutionary phase uses 256 candidates, 1900 generations, an annealed soft-min objective early in the search, exact max-min selection late in the search, periodic incumbent-centered restarts, and guaranteed elite retention. The final refinement is changed from only coordinate directions to active-set perturbations: it detects the point indices occurring in the currently smallest triangle constraints and preferentially perturbs those coordinates. This directly addresses the bottleneck triangles controlling the objective.
